title: Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
body:
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
Ro ke Bazar Main Deti Thi Sada Binte Ali (as)
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Nok e Neza se Sada deta Hai Ibn e Zehra (sa)
Log Zainab (sa) Ki Taraf Dekh Rahay Hain Baba
Zere Khanjar Nazar Ati Hai Tumhari Baiti
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Imteha'n Ghairat e Sajjad (as) Ka Kaisa Hoga
Qatal Darbar Main Sajjad Dobara Hoga
Mangnay Aya Hai Bachi Ko Kaneezi Main Shaaqi
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kehdo Zalim se Mujhay Maar le Aakar Dur’ra
Baba Zainab (sa) se Yeh Manzar Nahi Dekha Jata
Marta Hai Who Meray Bhai ke Honton Py Chari
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sar Khulay Sham Main Sadaat, Jidhar Jatay Hain
Log Pathar Liye Pehle Hi, Nazar Atay Hain
Aaj Bazar Main Mar Jaye, Na Koi Bibi
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aap ke Samne Jo Baat Nahi Karti Thi
Aaj Bazar Main Woh Beti Bhi Khutbay Degi
Aap ke Lehjay Ki Is Waqt, Zaroorat Hai Badi
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Abhi Darbar se Pehle Hi, Guzar Jayegi
Sun Liya Sani e Zahra (sa) Ne To Mar Jayegi
Log Kehte Hain Hussain (as) Ibn Ali (as) Ko Baghi
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Saray Bazar Ny Hans Hans ke, Tamasha Dekha
Aur Bhi Shimr Ny Is Baat Py, Is Ko Mara
Jab Tamanchon Py Sakina (sa) Yeh, Tarap Kar Boli
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Bab e Sa’at Ka Jo Bazar se Dekha Manzar
The Takallum Wahan Sub Log Uthaye Pathar
Sani e Zehra (sa) Yeh Kehti Hui Naqay se Giri
<<MINI>>
Ya Ali (as) Adrikni, Ya Ali (as) Adrikni
